QUOTE: "`archivedChannelsViewable(value)` returns `value !== 'false'` (line 304)." and "`archivedChannelsViewable(undefined)` evaluates `undefined !== 'false'`, which is `true`. So an absent setting means: ... The absent case is therefore the \"viewable\" path"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that only the literal 'false' turns the feature off and that a missing setting is treated as archived channels viewable.
